description:
Activate Crime Novelist using Triskelavus's ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite creature token.
Activate the Triskelavite by sacrificing it.
Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Resolve the Triskelavite ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
